title: Help shape ConquerCourse
intro: What stood out, what got in the way, and what should this world become? No sign-in or names. Please do not include personal information.

questions.text: What did you enjoy, notice, or want to try more of?
Was anything confusing, frustrating, or harder to understand than it should have been? What happened?
Did you get stuck on an obstacle, control, instruction, or other part of the experience? Tell us where and what you expected to happen.
What would you like to build, change, or bring into this world?
What other kind of world or place would you want to explore here? What could it help someone learn or understand?
Anything else you want us to know?
